scope: Exact five-track campaign; reservations, successful fits, qualified math and observed runtime are separate evidence.

requirements.requirement: Boundary-equivalent fused native execution of the existing model
Train and compare a simpler learned stencil and separable filters
Independent representation tests and complete solver gates
Repeated total pressure and native-fluid timing
Fixed selected-iteration policy
Measured stagnation-triggered policy
Coarser-hierarchy neural application
Neural calls, saved hierarchy work and full solve cost including decisions
Matched tiny replay and multi-iteration managed fits
Same initial tensors, sampling sequence and optimizer schedule
Finite CPU/CUDA objective/backward checks and fresh CPU restores
Coverage and cost after frozen selection, with actual forward counts
Cheaper retention and immutable shared basis storage
Deterministic admission based on expected savings, calibrated only on development
Cold, repeated, abrupt and context-reset independent tests
Fixed-zero/fixed-four/adaptive native work, cost and drift
At least 256 consecutive requested timesteps on two independent scenes
Full-field pressure, staggered velocity and tracer drift against independent reference
Multiple new 256-cells-per-axis scenes
Independent grid-dimension and cells-per-metre comparisons
Use observed failures to decide whether rollout training or further architecture changes are justified

limitations: Failures must stay visible; no pressure rejection may advance
execution_note: One discarded partial attempt hit the existing1800-second ceiling. Its outcome does not count as a completed scientific contrast.
